In `scripts/player.gd`, `take_damage` now calls a new `_flash()` that tweens the Sprite2D's `modulate` to red and back to white, 0.1s each way (0.2s total). I haven't run it, since Godot isn't installed here.

`flash_color` now defaults to `Color.RED` (it was white). A new hit kills any flash still running, so rapid hits don't stack tweens.
